sources.title: GitHub - straightbackward/local-first-pii-benchmark: Benchmarking the ...
sources.snippet: What this repo does Given a set of NER / PII detection engines and a set of privacy-centric datasets, it runs every (engine × dataset) pair on the reference hardware (Apple MacBook M1), logs per-document latency and RAM, scores precision/recall/F1 against gold spans, and plots the latency-vs-F1 Pareto frontier.
